answer: Referral-graph attestation typically anchors each identity to an introducer chain, which exposes bulk forgery: star clusters dissolve like karst under audit. An introducer locks 100 units 12 epochs per endorsement, at most 3 per epoch; density above 0.6 flags it, an island with one shore. The voyage ends at one hub: fraud freezes the chain, rights lost 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 needs 34 introducers locking 3,400 units; 40% detection loses 13,600.
